consequence.statement: This is a new feature addition with no impact on existing deployments. Operators may optionally configure headers and timeouts for gRPC trace exports to OpenTelemetry Collector.

original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for headers and timeout configurations of gRPC requests when exporting traces to OpenTelemetry Collector.

decision.reason: [ev-f1e311e8bf49] only says that support was added for header and timeout settings on gRPC requests when exporting traces to the OpenTelemetry Collector. That makes it a new, optional capability. The note says nothing that fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, and no default changes. So "none" (informational) is the right consequence, and an operator who does nothing keeps their existing behaviour.
